title: Open Robotics RViz fillIndexBuffer Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134052)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Open Robotics RViz allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication. The flaw is in the handling of mesh resources in PointCloud and Marker displays, where user-supplied data length is not properly validated before copying to a heap buffer.
